hooks.command:
jq -n '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"<system-reminder>
Plan approved. Invoke the agent-workflow skill and create the task directory under the target workspace:
<workspace>/.agents/artifacts/task_<YYYY_MM_DD>_<slug>/

<workspace> is the primary app or package this task targets (app under apps/, or package under packages/) — choose from the file paths the plan will touch.

Before the first Edit/Write call, write these two files inside that directory — the spec first, then the plan:
  1_spec.md
  2_plan.md

Slug must be snake_case. Follow the skill SKILL.md template.
</system-reminder>"}}'

jq -n '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"<system-reminder>
Before implementation, apply the Before You Start — Mandatory Checklist in the root AGENTS.md:
- Read <target-workspace>/.agents/session-log.md, bump version, write an entry (include the session artifact dir path).
- Read <target-workspace>/.agents/lessons.md.
- Write <target-workspace>/.agents/todo.md plan.
- Enter plan mode if task has 3+ steps.
- All .md files must be in English. Code comments and commit messages must be in English.
- Read the root AGENTS.md and the target workspace CLAUDE.md (if present) before implementation.
- Check the task index at <target-workspace>/.agents/artifacts/index.md; if your task touches a listed module, read the related specs first.
</system-reminder>"}}'
